newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the Panhandle area late Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,800 slaughter steers and 1,500 heifers; 85,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,900 formulated and 1,000 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00. Pen select and choice 2-3 1300 lbs Holsteins 58.00.
Wk to date: 85,600 Week Ago: 93,000 Year Ago: 94,100
